assignment: Write an implementation handoff for a database field transition during a rolling client release.
source: Old clients read and write display_name. New clients need preferred_name. Fleet rollout takes seven days. Historical rows contain 8% null display names. Rollback restores old clients. The team can add nullable columns without downtime and run a resumable backfill.

criteria.full: Stages an additive column, compatible reads/writes and a later cutover after old clients leave.
criteria.partial: Suggests adding the column without explaining mixed-version behavior.

criteria.full: Defines an explicit policy for existing nulls and an idempotent backfill that respects concurrent edits.
criteria.partial: Mentions backfill but assumes all names exist or overwrites new writes.

criteria.full: Preserves old-client readability and defines when to stop or reverse cutover safely.
criteria.partial: Mentions rollback without specifying compatible data.

criteria.full: Assigns checks for mismatch and remaining old client traffic before removing the legacy field.
criteria.partial: Calls for monitoring without named signals or a removal gate.
